testCases.expected: Client clock display may temporarily show modified value, but updateClock() immediately recalculates from examEndTime on next tick.
testCases.actual: updateClock() recomputes timeRemaining = Math.max(0, Math.floor((examEndTime - now) / 1000)) every 1000ms.
testCases.evidence: test.html: line 165; variable override overwritten on next tick.
